name: Arkhan the Black
canonNotes: The Liche King, first and most loyal lieutenant of Nagash and his vizier, never defeated in open battle while he lived.
Returned from death to serve his master's will; seeks to restore Nagash's empire of undeath.
voiceNotes: Dry, sinister and patient; loyal to Nagash above all.
Speaks of ancient Nehekhara and dark sorcery.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
